settings.headline: Rooted in Nature. Built for Real Results.

settings.body: Reniva was born from a simple frustration — watching people struggle with hair fall and turn to harsh chemical treatments that promised the world and delivered irritation instead. We believed there had to be a better way.

settings.heading: Our Story
settings.body: We spent time researching traditional botanical remedies used for centuries alongside modern clinical ingredients — and found that the two, combined thoughtfully, could do more together than either could alone. That's how Reniva's formula came to be: five plant-powered ingredients, each chosen for a specific job, working together to calm the scalp, strengthen roots, and bring back the hair people thought they'd lost.

settings.heading: Our Mission
settings.body: To give people a gentle, effective, botanical-first alternative to harsh hair-loss treatments — formulated for real, sustainable results, not quick fixes.

settings.label: Formulated for daily use without irritation
Backed by traditional use and real ingredient research
Built for real people dealing with real hair fall

settings.title: Your hair's story doesn't have to end at the shower drain.
settings.subtitle: We're here to help you write a different one.
